name: Swisher x 5-Pack .5g Infused Blunts | Original
description:
Experience the familiar taste of nostalgia with Swisher Blunts Original - our classic, redefined.

Swisher 5-Pack Infused Blunts feature five 0.5-gram blunts crafted with quality flower and enhanced with cannabis concentrate for added potency and flavor. Designed for a slow, even burn, they deliver smooth smoke with bold, consistent effects. A convenient option for consumers looking for a flavorful, high-potency blunt experience.
